Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: **Forecast models and official guidance point to a maximum temperature near 23°C in Warsaw on August 22, 2026, as the dominant driver of the 87.5% market-implied probability.** A late-summer synoptic pattern featuring increased cloud cover, light winds, and scattered thundery showers—consistent with ensemble outputs from European and global models—has moderated daytime heating and narrowed the expected range to roughly 19–23°C. This aligns with climatological trends showing August highs declining from mid-month peaks near 24–25°C toward seasonal averages around 22°C. Recent updates highlight precipitation timing and boundary-layer mixing as key uncertainties that could shift the outcome by 1–2°C, while probabilities for 24°C or higher remain low at 8.6% absent stronger insolation or clearer skies. Traders have weighted official meteorological consensus heavily, reflecting the skin-in-the-game assessment of these atmospheric controls.

This market will resolve based on the highest temperature recorded in the 'Daily Observations' table on Weather Underground, not the figure displayed in the 'Day High & Low' summary section; in the event of any discrepancy between the two, the Daily Observations table shall be the primary resolution source not the Day High & Low section.

This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 23 Aug '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Ninoy Aquino International Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/ph/manila/RPLL.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: Traders have concentrated the highest implied probability on a 31°C peak for Manila on August 23, reflecting the typical late-August climatology under the southwest monsoon, with 30–32°C outcomes together commanding over 75% of the market. Official PAGASA guidance and ensemble model runs indicate near-normal conditions with moderate cloud cover and scattered showers moderating daytime heating, while the urban heat island effect and light winds support the upper end of that range. Key variables include any shifts in monsoon strength or timing of convective activity that could suppress or enhance insolation, plus model spread in boundary-layer moisture. With resolution imminent, fresh PAGASA updates and high-resolution model consensus will be the main drivers of further price movement.
